verbatim_excerpt: For the purposes of this Section, buildings that abutted one another on a single zoning lot on the date of such damage or destruction shall be considered a single building.
capture_does_not_establish: This capture does NOT make any legal reading. It records only the group provision under which §54-41 sits: for the purposes of that Section, buildings that abutted one another on a single zoning lot on the date of damage or destruction count as a single building. Whether any two buildings 'abutted' and whether they share one zoning lot are factual/legal determinations left to a rule author and G6.
